summary:
StackOverflowError from JsonNode.toString() on deeply nested trees. The fix
(commit a1fa4ae4e, issue #3447: InternalNodeMapper serializes JsonNode trees
without recursion, with DeepJsonNodeSerTest) is already in 2.14.0-rc2; it first
shipped in 2.14.0-rc1 (`git merge-base --is-ancestor a1fa4ae4e
jackson-databind-2.14.0-rc2` succeeds). The advisory's patched version is
2.14.0 and its affected range ends at 2.13.5; trivy flags this pre-release only
because 2.14.0-rc2 sorts below 2.14.0.
